metaDescription: Order custom bistro mugs with spoon for your business. Perfect for coffee breaks. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Bistro mugs with a matching spoon add a touch of convenience and elegance to your branded drinkware. Whether you are outfitting a breakroom or creating a gift set for clients, the included spoon ensures your logo is always part of the coffee or tea ritual. These mugs are available in ceramic or stoneware, with the spoon often doubling as a stir stick or even a small spoon for sugar. Decorate with screen printing or full-wrap imprint for maximum visibility during every sip.
